951f050cb1.q: Why is AI-powered cybersecurity becoming a major revenue opportunity for MSPs compared to traditional security services?
951f050cb1.a: For the first time in 20 years, end clients are proactively asking MSPs how they can use AI, rather than MSPs having to sell security services to reluctant small businesses. MSPs can respond to this customer demand by packaging AI governance as a service and AI preparedness using Microsoft Purview, DLP, and sensitivity labeling—enabling security rollouts that deliver productivity gains while protecting data.

98ae62cb0f.q: What governance and data protection foundations must be in place before enabling Microsoft Copilot in a tenant?
98ae62cb0f.a: Copilot works within your existing Microsoft tenant access rules and permissions. If your tenant has sprawl and uncontrolled access, Copilot will expose that information to anyone who asks—employees can retrieve salary data, HR complaints, or confidential files they shouldn't access. Setting up sensitivity labels and data protection policies through Microsoft Purview is essential, and for small businesses, this can now be configured in an afternoon rather than requiring massive enterprise-level projects.

90a306d878.q: What is the three-question framework that MSPs should apply to justify any AI or technology investment?
90a306d878.a: The three questions are: Does this help me increase revenue, decrease cost, or mitigate risk? If you don't have a yes to any of those three, it's probably not a justifiable expense. The more yeses you get, the more strongly you should lean into the investment—whether for AI tools, equipment, or other business initiatives.

52dea7c50d.q: How should MSPs structure their first 90-day AI activation plan for customers?
52dea7c50d.a: Start with the customer's desired outcome and define success metrics—whether they want to improve quality, speed, or buy back time (QST framework). Then reverse-engineer the use cases and governance requirements needed to achieve that outcome. Begin with a clear outcome, align the activation plan around business results, and ensure governance and security are the foundation of the entire journey.
